desc: Prove construction: A = N+1, M = N^2; binomial expansion (1+N)^k ≡ 1 + kN (mod N^2), so A^k ≡ 1 (mod M) iff N | k, order exactly N.
Handle edge case N = 1: M = 1, A = 2; 2^1 − 1 = 1 divisible by 1, smallest n = 1.
Verify bounds: N ≤ 10^9 gives A = N+1 ≤ 10^9+1 ≤ 10^18, M = N^2 ≤ 10^18, both positive.
Implement solver: read T, loop over N values, print f"{N+1} {N*N}" per line using fast I/O (sys.stdin.buffer.read, '\n'.join output).
Sanity-check sample logic mentally (N=3 → (4,9) order 3; N=16 → (17,256) order 16).
